cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 reports a certification, audit or assurance level for the system.
cells.note: Stage 4: in September 2026 ANATS says SIGPTS assigns each person a unique NNI after enrolment and deduplication, and a 2025 account says the system deduplicates biometrics against 15 million records. No certification, audit or assurance level is held, so stage 5 is not met.
